purpose: Define the provider-agnostic task execution envelope CYNIC uses to route one agent task across N use cases, N execution paths, N reasons, N alternatives, N evidence levels and N fallback routes.
contract_rules: The envelope is polymorphic: Hermes Agent is the default agentic execution route when its observed capabilities satisfy the use case, but no provider name is an authority.

Before introducing or rebuilding an agent runtime capability inside CYNIC, route selection must check whether the default Hermes Agent substrate already provides it through an adapter-compatible surface.
Every use case must carry intent, why, paths, expected outputs, constraints, fallback routes and what_else probes.
Every route candidate must declare provider, transport, required capabilities, toolset policy, side-effect policy, risk and required evidence.
Repo writes remain forbidden unless a route explicitly carries repo_write_requires_claim and the runtime adapter proves coordination claims before mutation.
Execution results must normalize back into cynic.agent_task_result.v1 or a declared output schema before the mempool is considered updated.
The envelope should be generated before provider-specific prompt compilation so route selection remains auditable.

provider_policy.default_provider_condition: Use Hermes Agent first when capability, schema compatibility, transport availability, risk, side-effect policy and evidence requirements are satisfied.
